text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Where... am I?
It's pitch black... and I can't see a thing, but...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, heavens.
To think I would end up a prisoner...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if it's all of you,
I'm sure you will save me.
Please, find this place...!”

――The whole thing started
a few days ago.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please listen, Trainer.
It seems everyone is willing to play
the "Captive Saint" game with me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they understood my desire to feel like
a kidnapped maiden... Fufu, everyone is just
so kind and considerate.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I wonder where I should hole up. Trainer,
you must do your best to track me down, alright?

And so, from Team DREAMS, <nickname> and two others
kicked off the search operation!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: How could anyone know that?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, if I just knew the place,
I'd kick down an iron door if I had to!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave finding the spot to me♪
I'll show you something interesting.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—!? What's this?
There's so many different landscapes on the display.
choice_data_list: Could it be... a live broadcast?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah, so many municipalities are broadcasting it now, so I opened a bunch of windows and lined them up.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: If somewhere among these, there's a shadow that fits the description...
choice_data_list: Huh? Just now, a bright red outfit at the window...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
――!!
Alright, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-san, Espo-san...!
You found me,
thank you so much."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, if you wanna thank someone, thank Loves.
All I did was kick the damn door in.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm used to gathering information online. Thank you for the fun riddle-solving game, Desire-san♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the place I'm aiming for is somewhere
far from here. But still—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Having someone to play with me like this...
this place isn't half bad either, is it? ♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I asked the rest of the community members to check too,
but there haven't been any sightings...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if even someone with Loves's wide network
can't find them, and they aren't caught in any online net either...
That must mean—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: We've gotta spark some innovation, right?! I'll come up with a totally different approach for ya!
choice_data_list: What do you mean by a completely different approach?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Loves, do you know anyone
who's a carrot farmer?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A carrot... farmer?
Come to think of it, I feel like one of my community members was a charismatic grower who made super delicious carrots.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Yes, so Desire is—right there!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe that wasn't quite the right way to put it.
Desire will simply be there!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Carrots, carrots...
Ah, carrots...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yan-ko-san! Is it true there are carrots here so delicious they melt in your mouth?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Totes for real!
And while we're at it—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"And the Saint's rescue is all complete!
Just like that!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Lured by my favorite food,
I ended up coming right out...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I see, if we can't find them, we lure them out.
That's the plan, right!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yup! How was it, Desire?
Did you enjoy playing captive?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The place I'm aiming for
is somewhere far away from here. But—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Having someone to play with me like this...
this place isn't half bad either, is it? ♪"

Red Desire looked happy
to have the three of them play with her.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is it true!? Did you really find out
where Desire went after skipping out?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a bit of a tricky spot, though.
Yeah, it's kind of a tricky spot, though.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha, as long as I know where it is, I can handle anything.
Let's go, Marche!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Yes, Espo-san!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey! We gotta move all this crap
just to get through!?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"*Pant... pant...* I can't...
I'm so groggy~..."

Though we found her location...
Red Desire had holed herself up in the remote island's pantry.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Such a drag, seriously... Hey, Marche!
Say something to get me fired up.
choice_data_list: (Something to get fired up about, huh...)

text_block_list.text: Normally, she'd cheer her on. As I watch to see how Marche Lorraine encourages her...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "T-To be exhausted already... How pathetic of you, Espo-san!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I never thought she was such a weak Umamusume.
Ah, what a disappointment~."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—!? D-Damn it... Y-You bastard...
Who the hell...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Who're you callin' a weak Umamusume! I'm strong, damn it!
Take this, and this, and thiiis!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Espo-san,
Marche-san. I can't believe you actually came!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, but with me and Marche on the job,
it's a piece of cake. Marche, you've got some nerve
provokin' me like that, though.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe... I was a little scared, though.
I'm so glad I was able to find Desire-san~"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm happy too. The place I'm aiming for
is somewhere far away from here, but still—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Having someone to play with me like this...
this place isn't half bad either, is it? ♪"

Red Desire looked happy
to have the three of them play with her.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Desire! There she is! But...
she's crucified way up high like that!?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey!
Can't you find a way to break out on your own?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yan-ko-san... It's impossible... With the strength I have left, there's just no way...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
S-Such an intricate backstory...!
Hmm, what should I do here—

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up, Desire-san!
I'm a fairy of the forest.
I'm going to cheer you on with all my might~"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go, fight, fight, pi-pi-pi♪
Cheering magic, sparkle and shine~☆"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... how adorable!
Ah... power is surging from my inner holy fountain~!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I intended to stay up there until the end,
but I ended up coming down anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice going, Marche.
Using such pretty acting to make them come to you instead!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Ehehehe, yay!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the place I'm aiming for
is somewhere far away from here, but still—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Having someone to play with me like this...
this place isn't half bad either, is it? ♪"
